Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Bromodomain-containing protein 4. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Bromodomain-containing protein 4' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
